grammar.q: On rainy days, I would rather stay at home and read a book than [ ____ ] out with my friends. NEW
People who had practiced the speech in front of a mirror felt calmer than people who had not [ ____ ] . NEW
The volunteers cleaned the park, planted new trees, and [ ____ ] the old benches last weekend.
Many teenagers enjoy listening to music and [ ____ ] short videos on their phones before bed, even though it can worsen the quality of their sleep.
[ ____ ] the heavy traffic in the city center, the bus arrived at the station on time.
The students talked about [ ____ ] they should change the date of the school festival because of the ongoing construction.
The museum was closed for a week [ ____ ] the damage caused by the storm and the landslide that followed.
He decided not only to join the school band but also [ ____ ] the guitar.
Many visitors to the city do not know [ ____ ] the old palace was built more than five hundred years ago.
Some researchers argue that reading on paper is more effective than [ ____ ] on a screen for long texts.
[ ____ ] the students were preparing for the festival, it suddenly started to rain heavily.
The news [ ____ ] the school would build a new gym with the city’s approval made everyone in the town happy.
The coach wanted the players to rest well, eat healthy food, and [ ____ ] staying up late.
The prices of vegetables at the market are much higher than [ ____ ] at the supermarket, mainly because of the long drought earlier this summer.
Our club members collected used books, repaired them, and [ ____ ] them to a small village school with an outdated library.
The purpose of the program is to help students set goals and [ ____ ] them step by step.
Many people prefer walking to school to [ ____ ] the crowded bus during rush hour.
The weather was [ ____ ] cold that the outdoor events had to be moved into the gym, which caused a short delay in the schedule.
[ ____ ] its long history, the old market attracts thousands of tourists every weekend.
[ ____ ] the museum is small, it has one of the best collections of ancient coins.
Several students fell asleep [ ____ ] the long lecture on the history of economic theories.
Please keep your phones turned off [ ____ ] you are taking the final exam in the main hall.
The scientist was surprised by the fact [ ____ ] the plants grew faster in the dark room than in the sunny greenhouse.
[ ____ ] the survey clearly shows is that teenagers need more time for outdoor activities to support their mental wellbeing.
It is still not clear [ ____ ] the new rule will reduce the use of disposable plastic cups or not.
I wonder [ ____ ] the students will finish their science project before the deadline next week.
Neither the teacher nor the students [ ____ ] ready for the sudden fire drill in the morning.
The upgraded smartphone is not only light but also [ ____ ] to carry in a small pocket.
She spent the whole weekend reading books, writing letters, and [ ____ ] her room.
The population of this city is twice as large as [ ____ ] of the neighboring town, which has lost many young residents over the past ten years.
At the end of the year, the teacher asked the students [ ____ ] they wanted to study next semester.
The box was [ ____ ] a heavy one that two students had to carry it together.
[ ____ ] you join the reading club or not is entirely your own decision this semester.
The library is a place where students can study quietly and [ ____ ] books for free.
Learning to cook is as important as [ ____ ] to manage your money wisely.
The school excursion was canceled [ ____ ] the airline suddenly went on strike last week.
[ ____ ] the high price, the concert tickets were all gone within ten minutes.
Many people believe [ ____ ] exercising in the morning gives them more energy for the day.
The question is [ ____ ] we have enough money to finish the project this year without a government subsidy.
Both the students and the teacher [ ____ ] excited about the trip to the science museum.

arrange.ko: 학생들은 그 책을 읽을 뿐만 아니라 그것에 대해 토론하도록 요구받았다.
arrange.bogi: to discuss it / but also / not only / were asked / to read the book / the students
arrange.ans: The students were asked not only to read the book but also to discuss it.

arrange.ko: 날씨가 좋든 좋지 않든 축제는 계획대로 열릴 것이다.
arrange.bogi: will be held as planned / whether / the festival / the weather is good or not,
arrange.ans: Whether the weather is good or not, the festival will be held as planned.

arrange.ko: 폭우에도 불구하고 많은 사람들이 강변 공원에서 열린 그 음악 행사에 참석했다.
arrange.bogi: many people / the music event held in the riverside park / despite / attended / the heavy rain,
arrange.ans: Despite the heavy rain, many people attended the music event held in the riverside park.

arrange.ko: 성공은 얼마나 빨리 가느냐에 달려 있지 않다. 오히려, 얼마나 꾸준히 계속 가느냐에 달려 있다.
arrange.bogi: rather, it depends on / how fast you go. / success / how steadily you keep going / does not depend on
arrange.ans: Success does not depend on how fast you go. Rather, it depends on how steadily you keep going.

arrange.ko: 그 겨울옷 상자는 내가 혼자서 계단 위로 옮길 수 있을 만큼 충분히 가벼웠다.
arrange.bogi: to carry up the stairs by myself / the box of winter clothes / for me / was / light enough
arrange.ans: The box of winter clothes was light enough for me to carry up the stairs by myself.

arrange.ko: 코치는 경기 후에 선수들에게 운동장을 열 바퀴 돌게 했다.
arrange.bogi: run / the coach / ten laps / had / the players / around the field after the game
arrange.ans: The coach had the players run ten laps around the field after the game.

arrange.ko: 공사장의 시끄러운 소음은 내가 자정까지 잠들지 못하게 했다.
arrange.bogi: from / prevented / the loud noise from the construction site / falling asleep until midnight / me
arrange.ans: The loud noise from the construction site prevented me from falling asleep until midnight.

arrange.ko: Kuhn은 새로운 패러다임을 가진 과학자들이 이전에 보던 방식과는 다르게 세상을 본다고 믿었다.
arrange.bogi: from the way they had seen it before / that / Kuhn believed / see the world differently / scientists with a new paradigm
arrange.ans: Kuhn believed that scientists with a new paradigm see the world differently from the way they had seen it before.

arrange.ko: 숲을 베어 없애는 일은 공기 중의 이산화탄소를 늘릴 뿐만 아니라 산소의 양도 줄인다.
arrange.bogi: but also / carbon dioxide in the air / deforestation / reduces the amount of oxygen / not only increases
arrange.ans: Deforestation not only increases carbon dioxide in the air but also reduces the amount of oxygen.

arrange.ko: 밤이 너무 추워서 새벽에 방문했을 때는 우리 온실의 모든 농작물이 단단히 얼어 있었다.
arrange.bogi: were frozen solid when we visited at dawn / the night / that / was so cold / all the crops in our greenhouse
arrange.ans: The night was so cold that all the crops in our greenhouse were frozen solid when we visited at dawn.

arrange.ko: 그 독서 동아리는 학생들이 다양한 주제의 책을 읽고 서로 생각을 나누도록 돕는다.
arrange.bogi: share their ideas with one another / helps / read books on various topics / the reading club / students / and
arrange.ans: The reading club helps students read books on various topics and share their ideas with one another.

translate.en: However, the ants don’t eat these leaves. Instead, smaller worker ants take the pieces of leaves, chew them into smaller pieces, and use these as fertilizer to grow fungus in large underground ‘gardens.’
translate.ko: 하지만, 개미는 이 잎을 먹지 않는다. 대신에, 더 작은 일개미가 잎 조각을 가져다가 더 작은 조각으로 씹고, 그것들을 커다란 지하 ‘정원’에서 균류를 키우기 위한 비료로 사용한다.

translate.en: Raising the inner covers, which is difficult because they too are frozen, reveals a sight of hard, frost-coated leaves bleak enough to convince anyone that this idea is foolish.
translate.ko: 내부 덮개를 들어 올리는 것은, 그것 또한 얼어 있기 때문에 어려운데, 이 생각이 어리석다는 것을 누구에게라도 납득시킬 만큼 충분히 황량한, 뻣뻣하고 서리로 뒤덮인 잎의 광경을 드러낸다.

translate.en: Unfortunately, deforestation is preventing this process from being fully accomplished.
translate.ko: 불행하게도, 삼림 벌채는 이러한 과정이 온전히 이루어지는 것을 막고 있다.

translate.en: And with half of the Earth’s forests gone, the amount of carbon dioxide is progressively rising.
translate.ko: 그리고 지구 삼림의 절반이 사라지면서, 이산화탄소의 양은 점점 증가하고 있다.

translate.en: With millions of members in a colony, leaf-cutter ants cultivate their own food.
translate.ko: 한 군락에 수백만 마리의 구성원이 있는 절엽개미는 자신들의 먹이를 직접 재배한다.

translate.en: Instead, smaller worker ants take the pieces of leaves, chew them into smaller pieces, and use these as fertilizer to grow fungus in large underground ‘gardens.’
translate.ko: 대신에, 더 작은 일개미가 잎 조각을 가져다가 더 작은 조각으로 씹고, 그것들을 커다란 지하 ‘정원’에서 균류를 키우기 위한 비료로 사용한다.

translate.en: The ants feed the fungus, and the fungus blossoms into small fruiting bodies which the ants later eat.
translate.ko: 개미는 균류에게 먹이를 주고, 균류는 개미가 나중에 먹을 작은 자실체로 피어난다.

translate.en: Using this successful farming strategy, the ants build enormous nests underground, something spanning hundreds of square meters.
translate.ko: 이 성공적인 농업 전략을 사용하여, 개미는 지하에 수백 제곱미터에 달하는 거대한 둥지를 짓는다.

translate.en: Just like humans, they have perfected an agricultural civilization.
translate.ko: 인간과 마찬가지로, 그들은 농업 문명을 완성했다.
